items.html: And afterwards, in all of the seventh year and one day, the Chokhma of the Tzelem, which is within the first article of the Netzach of Tevunah, enters into the Chokhma of ZA; and the middle article of the Netzach of Tevunah descends below into the Chesed of ZA; and the third article of the Netzach of Tevunah descends into the Netzach of ZA. And behold, the entire right line is completed. And in the eighth year and one day, the Bina of the Tzelem, which is within the first article of the Hod of Tevunah, enters into the Bina of ZA; and the middle article of the Hod of Tevunah descends into the Gevura of ZA; and the third article of the Hod of Tevunah descends into the Hod of ZA; and then the entire left line is completed.
